name: Wild Forest
description: Dense woodland west of the river, untamed and resource-rich but dangerous at night.

name: Town Center
description: The heart of the settlement, where trade and daily life converge.

name: Town Outskirts
description: The eastern fringe of civilized territory, sparsely settled but patrolled.

name: Homes
description: Residential area near the town center where settlers sleep and recover.

name: Farm
description: Cultivated fields in the northeast corner, primary food production for the settlement.

name: Storage
description: Silo and stockpile zone at the edge of town center, reserve supplies not yet distributed.

name: Goblin Camp
description: A makeshift camp in the southern forest clearing, claimed by the goblin faction.

name: River
description: A swift-running river dividing wild and civilized territory, impassable except at the bridges.

name: Bridge
description: River crossings — contested neutral ground where the two factions sometimes meet.
